# OpenMausBot (adapted portions)

`LICENSE` is the full Apache License 2.0 text from OpenMausBot and `NOTICE`
records the attribution. CLmA source files that port OpenMausBot logic carry a
header like:

```kotlin
// Adapted from OpenMausBot (https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot),
// <original path>, Copyright 2026 Milind Soni and OpenMausBot contributors,
// Apache License 2.0 (third_party/openmausbot/LICENSE). Modified: ported to
// Kotlin and changed for CLmA.
```
